# Transcribing a practice recording locally

A speech recognizer can process an audio file on the workstation when its model files are already available. Run a short synthetic recording first and inspect the transcript manually. The transcription process can then run with the network disconnected.

This workflow accepts audio, not scanned pages. It needs enough memory and compute for the selected model. Keep the original recording and avoid treating a plausible transcript as a verbatim record without review. Downloading model files is preparation, separate from sending recordings to a service.
